content:
Assessed goods evidence can support reclassification of a specified SERVICE amount into MARKET_B. The evidence must match the batch and sample, and its unused supported amount must cover the requested amount.

The operation costs 100 cents and completes after five minutes, creating a separate traceable lot. Principal moves between lots without changing account cash or creating quota. Reuploading the same file does not multiply its supported amount.
